name: azure_accounts
description: Enumerate cached Azure CLI subscription candidates across reviewed clouds without acquiring tokens or selecting a current account.

name: azure_context_open
description: Open an immutable authorization context with explicit cloud bindings, subscription allowlists, graph/logs scopes, pinned token identities, and optional artifacts.write. Up to 8 operations in one context may run concurrently; every operation passes its cloud explicitly.

name: azure_context_close
description: Close an authorization context and cancel its active operations.

name: azure_request
description: Read one reviewed ARM route within the context subscription allowlist. Pass the cloud explicitly and use azure_schema_get for the exact relative path and API version.

apiVersion.description: Exact reviewed API version; use azure_schema_get for the route.

path.description: Path relative to the selected subscription, matching a reviewed route.

name: azure_graph
description: Query Resource Graph within the context graph scope. Optional subscriptions narrow the selection; scope allAccessible requires that explicit context grant.

name: azure_metrics_single
description: Read Azure Monitor metrics for one resource within the context subscription allowlist.

name: azure_metrics_batch
description: Read Azure Monitor metrics for up to 50 resources of the same type in one allowed subscription, using an explicit regional endpoint.

name: azure_logs_query
description: Run bounded KQL against a Log Analytics workspace. Requires logs.query and the cloud allAccessible logs scope. workspaceId is the workspace properties.customerId GUID.

timespan.description: ISO-8601 duration from PT1S through P30D; the host rejects zero and overlong durations.

name: azure_export
description: Execute one authorized Azure operation and publish its entire helper JSON as a private create-only local .json file, optionally LZ4 compressed as .json.lz4. Requires artifacts.write. Publication completes only after the operation and export succeed; the returned receipt identifies the stored file. arguments contains the chosen operation fields without contextId.

apiVersion.description: Exact reviewed API version; use azure_schema_get for the route.

path.description: Path relative to the selected subscription, matching a reviewed route.

timespan.description: ISO-8601 duration from PT1S through P30D; the host rejects zero and overlong durations.

name: azure_schema_search
description: Search the offline reviewed route catalog for an authorization context. Results identify the MCP execution tool, audience, grants, exact API versions, and context executability; use azure_schema_get for closed tool inputs.

name: azure_schema_get
description: Get one offline reviewed route at an exact API version. argumentSchema describes the MCP tool input, including contextId, separately from the host-owned HTTP body schema. Response schemas are metadataOnly unless a checked-in fixture exists.
